Use case: stylized-concept, production 2D cinematic VFX sprite for Yautja The Long Hunt.
Asset ID: arrival-impact-front-jungle.
Use the provided game screenshot ONLY to match the realistic painted 2.5D rendering and restrained material detail; do not reproduce its scene, pod, characters, interface, ground plane, framing or text.
Create ONE isolated ground-impact effect: a low, wide, asymmetrical radial fan of damp dark jungle soil with torn leaf litter and a few tiny earthen particles thrown outwards from a single central ground contact. The central opening remains mostly clear so a landing capsule can be composited behind. Dense earthy grey-brown particulate at the base, branching lateral fingers, a few subdued olive leaf scraps, physically plausible softer semi-transparent suspended dust at the top. The effect is a single cohesive plume, not separate panels or multiple examples. No explosion, no fire, no magical glow.
Camera: near-ground side view with a slight view of the top of the radial fan, as in the reference. Contact origin at horizontal centre and 78% down the full canvas. Widest spray spans x=15% to85%; topmost particle no higher than y=25%; no visible material below85%. Every edge fades to genuine transparent alpha, with at least12% empty transparent padding on all four sides.
Output: one landscape RGBA PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, ideally1536x1024. Semi-realistic hand-painted cinematic material, high silhouette readability at250px wide, detailed organic shapes without photorealistic background, subtle neutral upper-left lighting. Preserve warm grey/brown values; no thick black outlines.
Exclude: ship, capsule, people, creatures, lettering, words, grid, sprite sheet, numbered frames, contact sheet, ground disc, scenery, horizon, black or white background, baked checkerboard, rectangular haze, cropped particles, watermark.
This is one distinct impact-front sprite; no atlas.
